user.title: Add Zendure device
user.description: Devices are normally found automatically. Add one by hand only when it never shows up.

data_description.prodkey: The productKey the Zendure cloud reports for the device.
data_description.device_id: The deviceKey the Zendure cloud reports for the device.
data_description.sn: The serial number on the device label.
data_description.ip: Fixed address for the local API; learned automatically when empty.
data_description.blemac: Learned automatically from the Bluetooth advertisement when empty.

reconfigure.title: {name}
reconfigure.description: The name of a device never changes; its addresses can.

data_description.ip: Fixed address for the local API; learned automatically when empty.
data_description.blemac: Learned automatically from the Bluetooth advertisement when empty.

temp_entity.name: Temperature sensor
temp_entity.description: The sensor that measures the temperature of this store.

power_entity.name: Power measurement
power_entity.description: Sensor with the electrical power or the current of this device. Amperes are converted to watts using the phase.

switch_entity.name: Release
switch_entity.description: While this is on the solver may schedule this device.

control_entity.name: Control
control_entity.description: Number or climate the plan is written to every quarter, in the type chosen under Control type.

control.name: Control type
control.description: What is written to the linked entity: the temperature delta (offset in K), the electrical power, the capacity in percent or the temperature.

setpoint_entity.name: Setpoint from entity
setpoint_entity.description: A thermostat (climate), number or sensor that sets the setpoint. Empty: the setpoint above.

ambient_entity.name: Ambient sensor
ambient_entity.description: Sensor in the room the tank stands in. Empty uses the configured ambient temperature.

t_max.name: Upper bound
t_max.description: Highest temperature the solver may charge to. Higher means more buffer.

legionella.name: Legionella run
legionella.description: This tank needs a periodic thermal disinfection up to its upper limit.

legionella_days.name: Legionella interval
legionella_days.description: Days between two legionella runs. NEN 1006 asks for weekly.

legionella_band.name: Legionella band
legionella_band.description: Days either side of that interval to pick the cheapest day from.

sensor_height.name: Sensor height
sensor_height.description: Where the temperature sensor sits in the tank.

bottom_entity.name: Bottom sensor
bottom_entity.description: Optional sensor at the bottom of the tank. The model then follows the bottom too.

top_entity.name: Top sensor
top_entity.description: Optional sensor at the top of the tank. The model then follows the top too.

setpoint.name: Setpoint
setpoint.description: Temperature the solver aims for. Between 17:00 and 23:00 it is always reached.

ambient.name: Ambient temperature
ambient.description: Temperature of the room this store loses its heat to.

heat_max.name: Heat output
heat_max.description: Maximum heat output of the heat pump in kW.

cop.name: COP
cop.description: Efficiency used to turn the heat output into electrical power.

phase.name: Phase
phase.description: Which phase this device is connected to. Determined from history every night.

max_power.name: Electrical power
max_power.description: Maximum electrical power in kW the solver may schedule.

volume.name: Volume
volume.description: Water content of the tank in litres. It gives the degrees per kWh exactly, so it replaces a calibration.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name; HA names the device and its entities after it.

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: Kind of appliance, a label only; the behaviour is the same for every kind.

latest_start_time.name: Latest start time
latest_start_time.description: Time (HH:MM) by which the cycle must have started; empty applies the default rule.

manage.name: Manage
manage.description: Off: ZenMaster never arms this appliance and never touches its switch.

power_rating.name: Power rating
power_rating.description: Power of a cycle in kW, used until a profile has been learned from history.

cycle_duration_slots.name: Cycle duration
cycle_duration_slots.description: Duration of a cycle in quarters of an hour, used until a profile has been learned.

charge_power_entity.name: Charge power setting
charge_power_entity.description: Number entity that sets the charger's power.

soc_entity.name: State of charge
soc_entity.description: Sensor with the car's state of charge in percent.

connected_entity.name: Connected
connected_entity.description: Binary sensor that tells whether the cable is connected.

departure_time.name: Departure time
departure_time.description: Time (HH:MM) by which the car must be charged.

ev_max_soc.name: Target state of charge
ev_max_soc.description: State of charge (0-1) to charge up to.

charge_compensation_eur_kwh.name: Price limit
charge_compensation_eur_kwh.description: Price per kWh under which charging pays; on solar only under a third of it.

capacity_kwh.name: Battery capacity
capacity_kwh.description: Capacity of the car battery in kWh.

max_power_kw.name: Maximum charge power
max_power_kw.description: Maximum power of the charger in kW.

derate_entity.name: Curtailment
derate_entity.description: Number entity that throttles the inverter; empty means it cannot curtail.

solver.name: Solver
solver.description: Plans the battery and the consumers against prices and the solar forecast. Off: the fleet runs on its own control and the planning tabs are hidden.

day_drop.name: Setback by day
day_drop.description: This many degrees the solver may drop below the setpoint between 07:00 and 17:00 when it pays.

night_drop.name: Setback at night
night_drop.description: This many degrees the solver may drop below the setpoint between 23:00 and 07:00 when it pays.

headroom.name: Room above setpoint
headroom.description: This many degrees above the setpoint the solver may heat the house to store heat.

ble.log_connecting: Connecting… (pick the device in the browser)
ble.log_done: Done: the device appears as soon as it reports to the broker.
ble.log_provisioned: Provisioning sent; waiting 25 s while the device switches over…

ble.title: Pair device via Bluetooth
